BF.why: BF CGI 2023 (complete code held): no tax on net wealth; full-text search for 'impôt sur la fortune', 'impôt sur le patrimoine', 'patrimoine net', 'fortune' finds only the UEMOA double-tax convention annexed

MU.replaces: ^Registration duty on the transfer of immovable property
MU.name: Registration duty on the transfer of immovable property (5 %)
MU.statute: Registration Duty Act (consolidated to Act 14 of 2026) s. 3, First Schedule Part I paras I and J (last amended by Act 37 of 2011, cio 15/12/11); Finance Act 2025 (Act 18 of 2025) and Finance Act 2026 checked: they do not amend paras I-J
MU.doc: First Schedule Part I: the adjudication, sale, resale, return and any other deed or judgment transferring an immovable property or its usufruct, with or without consideration, 5 % (para I where the price does not exceed 100 000 rupees, para J above). FA 2025 amended only s. 2, 2B, 3 (new s. 3(1G) for non-citizens from 1 July 2026), 14A, 17, 36, para K and Parts II and IV; FA 2026 repealed para K. The duty is borne by the buyer on the value.
unsupported: land transfer tax borne by the seller (Land (Duties and Taxes) Act, Second Schedule): the input has no seller-side transfer of immovables
first-time buyer and other exemptions of s. 3
